title: Why Aren't All Plants Renewable? (WAAPR)
description: Adds Recipies to 'dupe' just about every plant with itself and a piece of bonemeal.
body:
Are you ever in need of a certain plant or something but it's absolutely nowhere near where you're based? Or it's a plant that for some reason isn't renewable? (Cough cough spore blossom)

Well this fixes that... in a way- Basically any plant or plant adjacent item can be put in a crafting table as well as the plant, it will output TWO of that plant, I would have liked to make it so you can just bone meal the plant directly but I'm lowk too dumb for that.

You can actually also put any grass type block, like nylium or podzol or... grass- with bonemeal and a piece of dirt/netherack to get more of it as well, though in this case I guess it's less 'duping' it and more just spreading the grass type to another block within the inventory.

Also there is recipes for already renewable plants like tall flowers or grass.


Pronunced "Wah-Pre"
